mapper.select: select r.role_key from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
select role_id from sys_role where role_key = #{roleKey} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId} and role_id in (select role_id from sys_role where role_key in ('oa_president', 'oa_minister', 'oa_staff'))
mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) values (#{userId}, #{roleId})
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_date from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where r.role_key = #{roleKey} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_user set dept_id = #{deptId}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set user_name = #{userName}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
